name: Analyze Itc Binding Thermodynamics
description: Analyzes isothermal titration calorimetry (ITC) data to determine binding affinity and thermodynamic parameters.
detailed_description: Analyzes isothermal titration calorimetry (ITC) data to determine binding affinity and thermodynamic parameters.
when_to_use: When you need analyze itc binding thermodynamics analysis

parameters.itc_data_path: [Optional] Path to CSV or TSV file containing ITC thermogram data with columns for injection number, injection volume, and heat released/absorbed.
parameters.itc_data: [Optional] Raw ITC thermogram data as a numpy array with shape (n_injections, 3) containing injection number, injection volume, and heat.
parameters.temperature: [Optional] Temperature in Kelvin at which the experiment was conducted. (default: 298.15)
parameters.protein_concentration: [Optional] Initial concentration of protein in the cell in molar (M).
parameters.ligand_concentration: [Optional] Concentration of ligand in the syringe in molar (M).
